interactions.conditions: Assert U1.24=VBUS_IN; U1.18 reaches VBUS_IN only through R14; U1.9 reaches VBUS_OUT only through R13; U1.16=VBEN drives the PMOS gate network; U1.1/5 bridge through R19/R20 to CC1/CC2; U1.22 and EP are GND; NC pins remain NC; U1.23=VREG_2V7 also bridges to R15.2/R16.2 (I2C pull-ups) and pogo pad J3.3, an external DC load beyond decoupling that DS12499 does not yet authorize

First power with load disconnected and current limit; use VDD 4.1..22 V or VSYS 3.0..5.5 V, common-ground I2C, wait beyond TLOAD, confirm gate remains deasserted detached before attaching a compliant source

Capture factory 40 bytes; diff intended normalized 40-byte image; write once within verified endurance; read all 40 bytes; reset and read; remove all power long enough for rails to collapse and read again; decode PDO/polarity/discharge fields and negotiate each intended profile

Observe unpowered Rd, reset Hi-Z, startup load, attach/negotiation, SNK_READY, detach, hard reset, lower-PDO transition, forced fault, VBUS discharge, VBUS_EN_SNK and POWER_OK/ATTACH polarity with scope and register snapshots
D6/D7 are DNP from CC1/CC2 to GND; if fitted, pin 1 must face CC and pin 2 GND; confirm capacitance and clamp behavior do not invalidate PD signaling or ST CC protection limits
R17/R18 are DNP CC-to-GND external Rd options while R19/R20 fit CCDB bridges; fitting both may parallel Rd and is prohibited until the exact intended topology and resistance tolerance are re-audited
